# Custom Music Folder

To add your own custom background song to the website:

1. Copy your audio file (MP3, M4A, WAV, or OGG format) into this folder (`public/music/`).
2. Rename your audio file to `song.mp3` (e.g. `public/music/song.mp3`).
3. Reload or open the website!

The music player button (vinyl icon in the top right corner) will automatically detect `song.mp3` and play your song on loop when clicked. If no custom file is found, it will automatically fall back to the built-in ambient music box.
